findings.problem: copier was chosen over cookiecutter for `copier update`, and docstrings promise 'copier update keeps this file in step', but the template is a subdirectory, not a git repo root: answers have no _commit and _src_path is the generating machine's absolute path; `copier update` in the generated service fails ('cannot obtain old template references')
findings.required_improvement: copier.yml at the GxG-hub root with _subdirectory: templates/python-fastmcp/template; render from the git URL with vcs_ref=kit_rev so answers carry _src_path=<url> and _commit; e2e test: generate at rev A, `copier update --vcs-ref B` applies template changes. Or drop the copier-update promise and its DoD-6 reason

findings.problem:
the git-mode .dockerignore (denylist) does not exclude .env (nor mutants, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache), while the template's .gitignore expects a local .env and the Dockerfile does `COPY . .`; a developer with

_PROVIDER_TOKEN in .env builds `docker build .` and the credential lands in /app/.env of the production image. Path mode: `!connectors/` also takes .env
findings.required_improvement: exclude .env / **/.env* and caches in both variants (or switch git mode to an allowlist: src, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, gxg-manifest.yaml, schemas); a test that renders both variants and asserts .env is excluded

findings.problem: the suite trusts the connector's own Running.calls() and Harness.failures with no positive control: broken copy 04 + `calls=lambda: 0` -> all 11 checks passed; broken copy 08 + `failures=("crash",)` -> MC-03 passed without exercising any mode. An honest harness counting the fixture backend while the service calls a real client is the same hole
findings.required_improvement: SC-10: assert running.calls() > 0 after a successful reader call; MC-03: assert {rate_limited, temporarily_unavailable} <= set(failures); add both as broken copies

findings.problem: (a) sample with the local jti cache replaced by an always-new one: EX-04 green, because the fake's dispatch CAS answers 409 and the check accepts 401 or 409; (b) sample with serves() returning True: all 19 checks green, no check sends a token for a tenant/connection/resource the service does not serve; serves() is domain code in every service and has no test in the template
findings.required_improvement: EX-04: replay must be refused without a second dispatch request (count dispatch calls in FakeApproval); EX-03: a token with a consistent ahs for an unserved resource and for another tenant -> 403, zero provider calls; two broken copies of sample

findings.problem: no check names a hidden resource in a list tool, an empty result or pagination: demo with (a) a hidden board in board_ids silently dropped, (b) an empty search returned as not_found, (c) next_cursor always null on a truncated page -> all green
